content.json:
## Prompt Shields — AI activity
Redaction, blocking, coaching and shadow-AI signals streamed from Prompt Shields into `PromptShieldsActivity_CL`.

**No prompt content is ever stored or shown here.** `PromptHash` lets you correlate the same prompt across events without revealing it.

parameters.name: AiToolFilter
parameters.label: AI tool
parameters.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| distinct AiTool
| order by AiTool asc

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    HighSeverity = countif(Severity == "High"),
    Blocked = countif(EventType == "Blocked"),
    ShadowAiTools = dcountif(AiTool, IsShadowAi),
    People = dcount(User)
| project
    ["Events"] = Events,
    ["High severity"] = HighSeverity,
    ["Blocked"] = Blocked,
    ["Shadow AI tools"] = ShadowAiTools,
    ["People"] = People
content.title: At a glance

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Activity over time, by event type

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    People = dcount(User),
    Blocked = countif(EventType == "Blocked"),
    Sanctioned = iff(anyif(IsShadowAi, true) == true, "Shadow AI", "Sanctioned")
    by AiTool
| order by Events desc
| take 20
content.title: AI tools in use — sanctioned vs shadow

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| where isnotempty(SensitiveType)
| summarize Events = count(), Spans = sum(RedactionTokenCount) by SensitiveType
| order by Events desc
| take 15
content.title: What kind of sensitive data is being caught

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| where isnotempty(Department)
| summarize Events = count(), HighSeverity = countif(Severity == "High") by Department
| order by HighSeverity desc, Events desc
| take 15
content.title: Where in the org this is happening

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| where Severity == "High"
| summarize
    HighSeverityEvents = count(),
    Tools = dcount(AiTool),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by User, Department
| order by HighSeverityEvents desc
| take 20
content.title: People with the most high-severity events

content.json:
### Investigation
`PromptHash` is a SHA-256 of the original prompt. It is stable across events, so the same prompt pasted into several tools correlates here without the prompt itself ever leaving Prompt Shields.

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| where Severity == "High"
| project TimeGenerated, User, Department, AiTool, IsShadowAi, EventType, SensitiveType, Detail, EndpointPlatform
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent high-severity events

content.query:
PromptShieldsActivity_CL
| where AiTool in ({AiToolFilter}) or "*" in ({AiToolFilter})
| summarize Occurrences = count(), Tools = make_set(AiTool, 5), People = dcount(User) by PromptHash
| where Occurrences > 1
| order by Occurrences desc
| take 20
content.title: The same prompt reaching multiple tools or people
